title: Half-density Hellinger bridge for the theta-half Kubo--Mori shell
question: Can the absolute theta-half Kubo--Mori shell be factored through the commutator and anticommutator of the Gibbs half-density, yielding a two-sided GNS/Hellinger bound that makes the square-root locality debt explicit?
promotion_boundary: R-378 is a finite exact half-density factorization and two-sided Hellinger/GNS interface. It turns the absolute Kubo--Mori shell into a geometric mean of a half-density commutator and anticommutator, but proves no uniform modular tail, common core, common alpha or QFT limit.
next_action: Prove a source-, volume- and cutoff-uniform two-sided half-density commutator/anticommutator estimate on one Hamiltonian-derived core; then feed the geometric-mean bound into the R-377 odd-resolvent budget and test both direct D and delta-D orientations.
boundary: Finite actual-Q3 edge and square doubled-bond Gibbs proxies with all prefixes, translations, signs and adjoints. The half-density identities, Cauchy bound and recovery of the R-371 arithmetic second-moment bound are checked numerically and in Lean; source/volume/cutoff uniformity, modular tails, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
